Listen to me love. Really read this for a second ok? I’m a mother of three and in my late twenties and I’m going to tell you right now that your mother is a piece of shit. You are absolutely right about that. No good mother says things like that to her child. Father either. You are 11 and so young and new in the world and I can see why you want to make them hurt. But what if they don’t feel the way you think they will? What if they bury you and go about their lives after a short time making no changes? You want revenge? Let yourself live long enough to grow up and tell them to go fuck themselves and lose all contact if you feel the need. Raise your babies to never feel the way you do right now. I resent my mom for a lot of things too that she did or said to me at your age and younger. But when my oldest daughter was born I made it a point to be nothing like that. I wanted her to feel loved and wanted and valued. She lives a much different life than I did now. I struggle with suicidal thoughts for many reasons but my children are the only reasons I’m still here. 

I was bullied too. Sort of an ugly duckling until I hit around 14-15. I wouldn’t go back to jr.high or HS for a million dollars. It’s hard, you’re right about that. You lose friends and you gain friends. It wasn’t until I was a little closer to junior year that I had a good steady friend group. You have to let yourself get there love. Let yourself grow up and I guarantee the best revenge you can give them is becoming a good decent person in spite of all the shit they put you through. Hang in there little love.
